exactStageCacheAdapter.scope: Exact binary stage persistence and unaccepted initial-seed retention only. Every original full nonlinear solve, Jacobian, positivity, line search and final audit gate remains.

exactRawWarmAdapter.scope: Only same-discretization raw warm storage and explicit GC. The original full residual, variational pass, Newton, line search, positivity and full audit remain unchanged.

endpoint.scope: Original stored metric with explicit frozen binary calibration lookup, complete historical profile fingerprints, bounded point memoization and shared linear graph grid, analytic endpoint rows, and immediate recovery-only recording of already accepted trials. No rational deep model or acceptance change.

frozenCalibrationAdapter.name: frozen-binary-calibration-lookup-v1
frozenCalibrationAdapter.scope: Saved binary alpha_n only for n<160. All original source cells, far transfers, graphs, physical quadrature and arithmetic order are retained. Global warp alpha is the saved binary datum. No recalibration, truncated head, new deep metric or nonlinear solution.

stored_metric.scope: The saved original binary alpha_n and global warp alpha are reused through a source-hash-locked lookup. All original physical formulas, arithmetic order, 160 cells and auxiliary far transfers remain; five- and seven-fraction historical fingerprints are checked. No rational deep replacement or physical recalibration.

stable_graph.name: tail-original-stored-shared-stable-graphs-v1
stable_graph.scope: Original stored metric and shared stable graph arithmetic. An already accepted trial is copied to the existing recovery-only progress recorder before the next variational pass. The pass, solve tolerance, positivity guard, line search and success definition remain unchanged.
